description: Runs `npm run typecheck` (in web/) before every git commit so type errors never slip through. `npm run build` is intentionally excluded — it depends on .env.local (Supabase env vars) that fresh worktrees don't have, and would false-block commits; build verification stays part of the manual PR quality-bar checklist / CI. SessionStart runs .claude/scripts/worktree-bootstrap.sh, which gives a fresh git worktree web/node_modules (APFS copy-on-write clone from the main checkout) and a symlinked web/.env.local — without it, npm test/format and that typecheck hook fail in every worktree. Also: guard-pbxproj.sh blocks hand edits to project.pbxproj; post-edit-sync.sh runs xcodegen on project.yml edits and prints fixture/token reminders; the commit typecheck only runs when web/ is in the commit. Edit hooks also match the multi-repo-context edit_file/write_file tools.
